en: Mounted on a herbarium sheet with pressed elm branches is a small sepia photographic postcard showing a riverside town with a bridge crossing the river, a compact cluster of houses on the slopes, and on the hilltop a large medieval castle and a prominent church tower. The lower-left corner of the postcard bears a printed caption. Surrounding the specimen are institutional labels from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.
